user.title: EV and Battery Charger
user.description: Calculates charging duration, planned charging start and end. Version 1.5.1 supports multiple calendars and activates a fallback charging window after 03:00 when a future event still exists today but the normal charging plan reports “Not needed”.

data.name: Name
data.full_charge_extra_minutes: Extra charging time at 100% target state of charge
data.Zusätzliche Ladezeit bei 100 % Ziel-Lade: Extra charging time at 100% target state of charge

data_description.name: Example: Cupra Leon or home battery
data_description.soc_sensor: Select the entity that provides the current state of charge in percent.
data_description.target_soc: Normal starting value of the target SOC entity. An eligible calendar event may temporarily raise it to 100% automatically.
data_description.target_time: The vehicle should be ready every day at this time.
data_description.target_source_priority: “Calendar event first” uses the earliest future event across the selected calendars. “Prefer daily overnight time” normally uses the daily ready time but switches to an earlier calendar event.
data_description.efficiency: Charging efficiency as a factor, for example 0.93 for 93%.
data_description.buffer_minutes: The planned charging end is this many minutes before the ready time. Default: 30 minutes.
data_description.full_charge_extra_minutes: Additional safety extension in minutes added only at a 100% target. Default: 10 minutes.
data_description.calendar_entity: Optional: select one or more calendar.* entities. All selected calendars are refreshed every 30 minutes. The earliest future event is used for the normal charging plan. After 03:00 an additional fallback applies: if a future event still exists today and the normal plan reports “Not needed”, a charging window from 03:00 until the event is activated regardless of SOC.
data_description.ziel_ladestand: Normal starting value of the target SOC entity. An eligible calendar event may temporarily raise it to 100% automatically.
data_description.Ziel-Ladestand: Normal starting value of the target SOC entity. An eligible calendar event may temporarily raise it to 100% automatically.
data_description.Zusätzliche Ladezeit bei 100 % Ziel-Lade: Additional safety extension in minutes added only at a 100% target. Default: 10 minutes.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EV and Battery Charger
reconfigure.description: Adjust the existing configuration. The integration will be reloaded automatically afterwards.

init.title: EV and Battery Charger options
init.description: Adjust entities, calendars, charging target logic, and charging parameters. Multiple calendars are supported. In addition, after 03:00 a simple calendar fallback applies: if a future event still exists today and the normal plan is “Not needed”, the status is changed to “Charging window” until the event starts.
